descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 30 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
An ultra-massive cyber‑attack is threatening to cut off your link to reality. To survive, think fast, gather memory cores, fortify your defenses, and react in real time to repel invaders. Do you dare?

**Xploit ZERO is a Mixed Reality action‑strategy game where your real room becomes the battlefield.**

[media]🔥 Fast, intense, replayable. Guaranteed fun

ℹ️ **Early Access & Community**

Xploit ZERO is available in Early Access with 5 fully playable levels and 2 difficulty settings, delivering hours of extreme fun from day one. Follow Xploit ZERO on social media and join us as we push innovation forward.
